exits.scores: scores and rankings: each entity's candidates ordered by the probability of the part's positive class, ties kept in the candidates' order, put back together as one answer
exits.top_k: top_k: the query's RANK TOP k, or the option in its place, keeps the k best of each entity's candidates; the outputs a ranking gives
exits.candidates: candidates: one part per distinct candidate, a candidate whose context holds one class left out unscored, a key the query cannot say refused of its part
exits.pd1: PD-1: a NaN score never reaches the order; the reference refuses a non-finite probability, said of the part's candidate
exits.parts: a part's failure said of its candidate, the calls after it unsent
exits.prediction_statistic: prediction_statistic: refused for a ranking, a regression's sent as the caller gave it
exits.response_field: response_field for rankings: scores and rankings an answer carries given back as the reference's, or refused where it refuses
exits.instance_id_type: instance_id_type: a payload whose instance id is neither an integer nor text, answered as the reference's
exits.prediction_type: prediction_type: a classification's answer not of its target's type, given back as the reference's
